transformation: Personal absolute paths are replaced by documented artifact IDs; runtime UUID/MAC/private endpoints are removed. Numeric observations and original artifact hashes are preserved.

checks.check: All registered monitor48 and flute10 cases, with no denominator change
Every frozen natural and synthetic quality criterion recomputed

limitations: Fresh board execution reuses frozen application inputs and registered PC-only expected outputs. It is a replication dataset.
All full Y values and strict power packets are compared; original frame statistics, complete metrics and signed complex/preliminary-mask fields remain unavailable in physical TSH2.
Native strict decoder checks FNV and packet invariants; independent Python reconstruction checks every header, index, threshold, power and all21 feature columns.
Monitor quality and byte ratios use only original5s/5.12s support. Natural event comparison is not labeled fault diagnosis.
Recorded FPGA cycles include HPS source/drain stalls; board/host intervals are service timing, not an isolated-core or energy/speedup benchmark.
No continuous microphone, live codec/ADC, original DDR/UDP architecture, long-duration reliability or industrial certification is established.
Audit performs no hardware access. It verifies the preserved fresh physical execution receipts and raw data.
